role: Gate: rebuilds the PathProbe region from final.bin.gz, replays the case draw stream, and calls the native pathfinder per case (entity size, position, target, flags), requiring the recorded path or null point for point, then compares the final region. --cases N (make smoke, probe.h): the first N cases, without final.bin.gz.
notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/paths. Native calls: pf_init, pf_free, pf_entity_set_position, pf_get_entity_path_to_xyz, pf_get_path_entity_to_entity (csrc/engine/pathfind.h), jr_seed/jr_next/jr_int_n, probe.h helpers (cmp_final, probe_loaded, probe_localize), world_*. --hash-all accepted and ignored. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/PathProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/paths/pf2-20k, pf42-20k. PathFinder member names are MCP names as remembered, not checked against the source.
